title: MigrateMsg
description: No-op migrate payload. The route engine's state (`ACTIVE_ROUTES`, `SUBMSG_REPLY_STATES`, ...) is transient within a single atomic tx, and the persistent stores (`CONFIG`, `FEE_MAP`, `FLASH_SIGNERS`, `TAX_TOKEN_REGISTRY`) are structurally unchanged, so no data migration is required — the `migrate` entry point only guards the contract identity and bumps the stored version.
